sources.note: Self-registered point in the 'Unidades productivas / Quintas /Huertas con venta directa' layer of the Rutas Sanas del Alimento map, kept by the Red Interregional de Nodos Agroecologicos. It publishes the unit's coordinates, its declared production and the contact route the producer entered; entries carry no date and no review. Declares an agroecological market garden with fruit trees, worm compost and farmhouse eggs at Monterrico, with the grower's mobile.

notes: The map carries a second registration, 'La Ovejería Productor Agroecologico', at the same coordinates and with the same contact person and phone, describing the same agroecological crops and hens; both are treated as one productive unit.

Self-registered point in the 'Unidades productivas / Quintas /Huertas con venta directa' layer of the Rutas Sanas del Alimento map, kept by the Red Interregional de Nodos Agroecologicos. It registers the garden at Uquía, Humahuaca, and declares agroecological vegetables made up into boxes for families in San Salvador de Jujuy.

notes: The map registers this garden a second time under the title 'Productorxs en Huerta Las Señoritas: Verduras Agroecológicas', with a different contact person and mobile from the ones the row already carried; the row keeps its own contacts and takes only the declared production from the map.
